slides.title: Word Card
slides.translation: A proposed explanation or prediction that can be tested through research or experiments
slides.context: Central to every research presentation — the prediction being tested.
slides.example: State a clear specific hypothesis directly tied to your experiments.

slides.title: Word Card
slides.translation: Specialized or technical language used by a particular group, often difficult for outsiders to understand
slides.context: Should be avoided or clearly defined in scientific presentations for general audiences.
slides.example: NEVER assume the audience knows more than you. Don't use jargon unless you define it clearly.
